extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction under rules 0.4 from the converted text file (text-file page = printed page + 2). Read the cover note, table of contents, executive summary (pp. 4-6), section 4 key structural challenges (pp. 17-31, including the indicator table), section 5 on the 2021 policy guidance (pp. 32-36), Annex A (pp. 37-46), Annex B indicators (pp. 47-50), Annex C (p. 51) and Annex D (pp. 52-53); remaining pages scanned by keyword. The document has no acquis chapter structure and no Chapter 2 material, so cluster and chapter are empty and all items are in scope on theme. Left out as outside the materiality test: the Public Revenue Office integrated IT tax system (measure 20, a tax IT upgrade), the State aid registry and management information system, the intelligent transport system on Corridor X, digitalisation of the energy system and smart grids, the electronic exchange between employment centres and centres for social work (back-office), and the stand-alone digital skills indicator in the tables. Policy guidance scores (for example 'Partial implementation') are the Commission's PG scale, not the enlargement report scale, so eu_scale is left empty. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
